50249584.protein: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3
50249584.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full-length His-tagged STAT3 (unknown origin) by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: In addition to FP, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) binding experiments were conducted to measure the kinetic association and dissociation using a ProteOn XPR36 (Biorad) with full-length His-tagged, STAT5, and STAT3 (SignalChem) immobilized on a biosensor chip. Most encouragingly, inhibitors exhibited potent nM binding affinities for STAT5, and selectivity for the STAT5 cf. STAT3 (Supporting Information Figure S2). Compound 13a exhibited the most potent K_D (k_off/k_on) of 42 ± 4 nM, with 7-fold selectivity for STAT5 cf. STAT3, K_D = 287 ± 29 nM (Figure 3C).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. (A) 13a docked with STAT5b; (B) FP binding traces for 13a against STAT5b and STAT3 protein; (C) SPR curves for 13a against STAT5b and STAT3 (5, 1.67, 0.56, 0.19 μM).
